targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS deger FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id) reachable FROM nvr_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, ts DESC) t WHERE reachable
SELECT count(*) AS deger FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id) reachable FROM nvr_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, ts DESC) t WHERE NOT reachable
SELECT count(*) AS deger FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id, disk_name) state FROM disk_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, disk_name, ts DESC) t WHERE state = 'error'
SELECT count(*) AS deger FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id, raid_name) state FROM raid_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, raid_name, ts DESC) t WHERE state IN ('degraded','failed','rebuilding')
SELECT min(retention_days) AS deger FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id) retention_days FROM retention_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, ts DESC) t

SELECT n.name AS cihaz, n.device_type AS model, n.software_version AS firmware, m.reachable AS erisilebilir, round(m.latency_ms::numeric,0) AS gecikme_ms, n.last_seen AS son_gorulme FROM nvr n LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT reachable, latency_ms FROM nvr_metrics WHERE nvr_id=n.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true ORDER BY n.name

SELECT n.name AS cihaz, d.disk_name AS birim, d.state AS durum, round(100.0*d.used_bytes/nullif(d.total_bytes,0),1) AS doluluk_pct, d.health_ok AS smart FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id, disk_name) * FROM disk_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, disk_name, ts DESC) d JOIN nvr n ON n.id=d.nvr_id UNION ALL SELECT n.name, r.raid_name, r.state, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (nvr_id, raid_name) * FROM raid_metrics ORDER BY nvr_id, raid_name, ts DESC) r JOIN nvr n ON n.id=r.nvr_id ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.ts AS time, n.name || ' ' || d.disk_name AS metric, 100.0*d.used_bytes/nullif(d.total_bytes,0) AS value FROM disk_metrics d JOIN nvr n ON n.id=d.nvr_id WHERE $__timeFilter(d.ts) AND d.total_bytes > 0 ORDER BY 1
SELECT r.ts AS time, n.name AS metric, r.retention_days AS value FROM retention_metrics r JOIN nvr n ON n.id=r.nvr_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT e.ts AS zaman, coalesce(n.name,'-') AS cihaz, e.code AS kod, e.severity AS onem, e.payload->>'message' AS mesaj FROM event e LEFT JOIN nvr n ON n.id=e.nvr_id ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50
